heard: Our sun and entire galaxy are being pulled across space. Astronomers thought a local pole called the Great Attractor was responsible, but that mysterious cosmic anchor is getting dragged along with us. The real Titan sits 650 million light-years away and centaurus. The Shapley Supercluster packs over 8,000 whole galaxies together. Its total mass exceeds 10 million billion suns combined. It is the most massive structure within a billion light-years, because right now, this monster is reeling our world across the dark.
